lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical rows of high-luminance spots, creating a faint grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal-facing edge to shadow on the ventral-facing edge.
